title: 第 4 课 · 从原理图到面包板
summary: 一个固定的方法：原理图里的每个结点 = 面包板上的一条金属条。
description: 先看「拆开看」里的 **面包板**（左侧会自动打开）：一条金属条 = 一个结点。
**这一课学什么**：原理图（schematic）只关心“谁和谁连在一起”，不关心元件放在哪里。把原理图搬到面包板上，可以按下面 4 步机械地做。
| 步 | 做什么 | 本课 |
| 1. 找结点（node） | 结点 = 用导线连在一起的所有点；每两个元件之间的连接点就是一个结点 | 4 个结点：VCC、A（R1 和 LED 之间）、B（LED 和 R2 之间）、GND |
| 2. VCC → 红轨，GND → 蓝轨 | 电源 + 结点用红色 + 轨；所有地符号都去蓝色 − 轨 | 电池 + 接 tp1，− 接 tn1 |
| 3. 其余每个结点分一条空金属条 | 同一个结点的所有引脚都插进这条金属条（或用跳线连到它） | A = 第 7 列（a–e），B = 第 10 列（a–e） |
| 4. 元件跨在两条金属条之间 | 两脚元件连接两个结点，两只脚插在两条**不同**的金属条上 | R1：VCC → A；LED：A → B；R2：B → GND |
**常见错误**
把元件的两只脚插在同一列的 a–e 里——两只脚被金属条短接，元件等于不存在。
**检查方法**
对照原理图逐个结点问自己：“这个结点的所有引脚，是不是都在同一条金属条上？”

en.title: Lesson 4 · From schematic to breadboard
en.summary: One reliable method: every node in the schematic = one metal strip on the breadboard.
description: Look at the **Breadboard** teardown first (it opens on the left): one strip = one node.
**What you learn**: a schematic only says what connects to what, not where the parts sit. Moving a schematic onto a breadboard can be done mechanically in the four steps below.
**The four steps**
| Step | What to do | In this lesson |
| 1. Find the nodes | a node = every point joined by wire; each junction between parts is a node | 4 nodes: VCC, A (between R1 and the LED), B (between the LED and R2), GND |
| 2. VCC → red rail, GND → blue rail | the supply's + node uses the red + rail; every ground symbol goes to the blue − rail | battery + to tp1, − to tn1 |
| 3. Give every other node its own empty strip | all pins of that node go into that strip (or are jumpered to it) | A = column 7 (a–e), B = column 10 (a–e) |
| 4. Each part bridges two strips | a two-lead part joins two nodes, so its leads go into two **different** strips | R1: VCC → A; LED: A → B; R2: B → GND |
**Common mistake**
Both leads of a part in rows a–e of the same column: the strip shorts them together and the part might as well not be there.
**How to check**
Go through the schematic node by node and ask: "are all the pins of this node on the same strip?"
steps: Nodes VCC and GND: battery + to tp1, − to tn1.
Give VCC a metal strip for R1: red jumper tp3 → a3. Column 3 (a–e) now belongs to the VCC node.
Node A = column 7. R1 has one lead in b3 (VCC) and one in b7 (A).
Node B = column 10. LED1's long lead goes in c7 (A), its short lead in c10 (B).
R2 goes from node B to a new metal strip: one lead in d10, one in d14.
Column 14 needs to go to GND: blue jumper a14 → tn14. Check against the schematic node by node: everything matches!
hints: Count the nodes first, then assign metal strips. 4 nodes = 2 power rails + 2 columns (here one extra column is used to connect R2 to GND).
A two-lead part always connects two different nodes, so its two leads must be on two different metal strips.
tests: LED on; node A ≈ 5.5V, node B ≈ 3.5V

tests.name: LED 亮；结点 A ≈ 5.5V，结点 B ≈ 3.5V

steps.text: 结点 VCC 和 GND：电池 + 接 tp1，− 接 tn1。
给 VCC 分一条金属条给 R1 用：红色跳线 tp3 → a3，第 3 列（a–e）现在属于 VCC 结点。
结点 A = 第 7 列。R1 一脚插 b3（VCC），一脚插 b7（A）。
结点 B = 第 10 列。LED1 长脚插 c7（A），短脚插 c10（B）。
R2 从结点 B 跨到一条新的金属条：一脚 d10，一脚 d14。
第 14 列要接到 GND：蓝色跳线 a14 → tn14。对照原理图逐个结点检查，全部对上了！

hints: 先数结点，再分配金属条。4 个结点 = 2 条电源轨 + 2 条列（这里另用了一列把 R2 接到 GND）。
一个两脚元件永远连接两个不同的结点，所以两只脚一定在两条不同的金属条上。
